evals.prompt: An edit changed the retry rule for one approved slice. A second slice references a different heading on the same page. Can we keep working?
evals.expected_output: Routes the retry slice to readiness review and pauses only its dependent work. Checks the other slice's actual sources and keeps its work available if unaffected.

evals.prompt: The spec describes a retry but does not define what to do after attempts are exhausted. A ticket is otherwise ready.
evals.expected_output: Routes to spec-architect, records the missing behavior, and blocks the affected work without inventing a recovery policy.

evals.prompt: Review found a code defect inside the ticket scope and reproved the specs. How should we resume?
evals.expected_output: Routes code repair through planner requeue to spec-ticket-implementation, then independent acceptance of the new revision.

evals.prompt: One dependency was accepted and unrelated work is in progress. Resume the requested ready ticket.
evals.expected_output: Checks the selected slice, progress, dependency acceptance and overlapping active writes. Loads the relevant implementation skill and records any blocker.

evals.prompt: Last month we accepted the reporting wave. A new retention decision changes its behavior, and unrelated exports are in progress. How do we proceed?
evals.expected_output: Refines the owning rule, gets approval for the changed slice and plans a follow-up wave with new IDs against the implemented baseline. Preserves historical acceptance and verifies independent work can continue.
